Explanation of the change:

- Original line:  
  ```js
  hljs.COMMENT('\(\*', '\*\)')
  ```
  was matching any “(*” (even in `Operators.(*)`) as the start of a comment.
- New line:  
  ```js
  hljs.COMMENT({ begin: /\(\*(?!\))/, end: /\*\)/ })
  ```
  only matches “(*” when it is not followed immediately by “)”, so operator calls like `(*)` will no longer be interpreted as comments.
